question: 오늘 강남지점 체결 건수와 거래대금 알려줘
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.BRANCH b ON c.BRANCH_CODE = b.BRANCH_CODE WHERE b.BRANCH_NAME = '강남지점' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE

question: 잔고가 1억 이상인 고객 이름과 총자산을 보여줘
sql: SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, TOTAL_ASSETS FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER WHERE TOTAL_ASSETS >= 100000000

question: 삼성전자 어제 체결 중 매수만 보여줘
sql: SELECT e.EXEC_ID, e.EXEC_QTY, e.EXEC_PRICE FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE p.PRODUCT_NAME = '삼성전자' AND o.SIDE = 'BUY' AND DATE(e.EXEC_TS) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY

question: VIP 고객 중 예수금 많은 순으로 10명
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(b.CASH_BALANCE) AS CASH FROM FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY b ON b.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE c.GRADE = 'VIP' AND b.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.BALANCE_DAILY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY CASH DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

question: 이번 달 약정 상위 고객 5명
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) = YEAR(CURRENT DATE) AND MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) = MONTH(CURRENT DATE) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY AMT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

question: 신용융자 계좌 보여줘
sql: SELECT ACCOUNT_ID FROM FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT WHERE CREDIT_LOAN_YN = 'Y'

question: 이번 달 체결대금 상위 고객 5명
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.ACCOUNT a ON o.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.CUSTOMER c ON a.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EXEC_TS) = YEAR(CURRENT DATE) AND MONTH(e.EXEC_TS) = MONTH(CURRENT DATE) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY AMT DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

question: 종목별 거래대금을 업종 내에서 순위 매겨줘
sql: SELECT p.SECTOR, p.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) AS AMT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.SECTOR ORDER BY SUM(e.EXEC_AMOUNT) DESC) AS RNK FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e JOIN FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o ON e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN FIN_DEMO.PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_CODE = p.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY p.SECTOR, p.PRODUCT_NAME

question: 주문 후 30분 넘게 미체결인 지정가 주문
sql: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM FIN_DEMO.ORDERS o WHERE o.ORDER_TYPE = 'LIMIT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_DEMO.EXECUTIONS e WHERE e.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID) AND o.ORDER_TS < CURRENT TIMESTAMP - 30 MINUTES

question: 한도 대비 노출금액 비율이 80%를 넘는 데스크가 있어?
sql: SELECT d.DESK_NAME FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS s JOIN FIN_DEMO.DESK d ON s.DESK_ID = d.DESK_ID WHERE s.BASE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(BASE_DATE) FROM FIN_DEMO.ST_POSITIONS) GROUP BY d.DESK_NAME, d.LIMIT_AMOUNT HAVING SUM(s.EXPOSURE_AMOUNT) / d.LIMIT_AMOUNT > 0.8
